legalMoves.description: Buy Roost Module (Ship part +3 Capacity) for 1200c (you have 1850c).

preview.then: Ship capacity +3. How many can be aboard, the captain included. Red shirts do not take a berth. Fitted at once.

legalMoves.description: Buy Talon-grip Stabilizers (Ship part +2 Handling) for 600c (you have 1850c).

preview.then: Ship handling +2. Added to an escape roll. Fitted at once.

legalMoves.description: Buy Imperial Targeting Array (Ship part Space Combat Advantage) for 600c (you have 1850c).

preview.then: The ship takes the higher pair in every exchange of fire. Fitted at once.

legalMoves.description: Buy Updraft Engine (Ship part +2 Speed) for 800c (you have 1850c).

preview.then: Ship speed +2. Each point takes one card off every leg of a trip. Fitted at once.

legalMoves.description: Buy Raptor Rifle (Weapon +2 GUN) for 600c (you have 1850c).

preview.then: +2 Gunslinging for whoever wears it. One weapon and one armor per being.

legalMoves.description: Buy Quiet-Feather Cloak (Armor +2 SNE) for 400c (you have 1850c).

preview.then: +2 Sneaking for whoever wears it. One weapon and one armor per being.

legalMoves.description: Depart for Habitat #3 — one-way trip, distance 12.

preview.then: A one-way trip of 12 cards. You do not come back to Kookookachaa: what its shop, cantina and missions still hold is left behind.
